result.summary: Closed the gap: confirmed the B07/B08 Chief<->Career Ops deterministic tracker interface (career-ops/career_ops_cli.py + tracker_writer.py) was already committed and green (no revert of the audit's emit() UnicodeEncodeError fix), and built the missing Monthly Tracker Rollover / archive worker (roster B09) as career-ops/tracker_rollover.py plus a deterministic department run-health module. Rollover rotates one closed month per region into uk-cyber-job-tracker.<YYYY-MM>.xlsx / <Region>_Cybersecurity_Job_Tracker.<YYYY-MM>.xlsx; the archive is built from a copy of the canonical workbook so sheets/table/formulas/number formats/data validations are inherited and every rotated cell (owner columns included) is copied verbatim, and the archive name matches the region archive glob so every rotated row feeds tracker_writer.build_cross_month_index (re-added postings are refused as duplicate-cross-month, 0 appends, proven in all four regions). Safety: dry-run by default; archive written+verified before the canonical is touched; canonical write = hash-verified backup -> temp write -> re-open verification -> concurrent-modification guard -> atomic replace; whole-run refusal when a row due to rotate carries owner-only column state (reported row/column only, value never in the result); refusal on a differing existing archive unless --force (hash-verified backup first); 'unchanged' on a byte-identical re-run; byte-identical restore from the backup. Tests: 32 new tests, whole career-ops suite 332 passed (was 300); the suite's final test asserts all four canonical workbooks are SHA-256 identical, and they were never written. Reversible acceptance on dated copies passed (exit 0, ok:true, uk/dubai/japan/singapore). Department run-health for tracker-writer (B08) and monthly-rollover (B09) is recorded in runtime/career-ops/run-health/*.json (last run, result, mode, row counts per region; aggregate only, no workbook content, excel_is_source_of_truth/orchestration-only stated) and read back via 'career_ops_cli.py run-health'. Registry skill references and state docs updated with verified facts only; committed and pushed (facc6e8..06d25f4). Regional lanes and Company Watch were not touched. Real finding: a read-only 2026-09 rollover plan refuses on live owner state (uk 26 rows: Jx5 application status, Kx21 priority; dubai 8 R; singapore 4 R; japan 0) - rotation was correctly refused rather than deleting owner records, and nothing was forced.

The worker refuses those rotations by design (run-health shows 'refused'); if you approve removing them, the run is 'career_ops_cli.py rollover --region R --month YYYY-MM --apply --allow-owner-state-removal' (hash-verified backup + verification always, and the owner-state value is preserved in the archive).
